compatibility_policy.failure_behavior: fail closed and display a compatibility reason without changing Steam, Gamescope, audio, CEC, or performance-overlay services

cecd.selection: exactly one managed playback endpoint with a strictly typed advisory Active boolean, a real physical address, and an allocated Playback logical address; AudioLogicalAddress is advisory

steam_ui.focus_action: unique SetFocusedAppWindowID prototype descriptor; source-validated direct action or source-validated MobX wrapper plus WindowStore class body
steam_ui.focus_lease_preconditions: Hidden composition state, zero request counters, zero owners, MainRunningAppID equals focused app, one positive focused native window, and cached selected window sentinel 0
steam_ui.focus_lease_release: after DOM removal and Notification hook release, restore sentinel 0 only when selected ID and singleton window list still match the owned lease

integration.game_visibility: Steam minimum Notification composition request with a transient fail-closed focused-window lease
integration.read_transport: /usr/bin/busctl addressed to the current unique owner
